answer: Time-locked staking typically requires each identity to lock 150 units for 20 epochs, and tends to punish bulk forgery by freezing capital rather than detecting each fake. Honest agents recover their stake at 5% per epoch while a beacon check confirms real work, whereas a forged identity that misses its proof has its timer reset and forfeits 60%, and the pigment of that loss stays visible on the ledger. A whisper triggers review, and 1,000 clones lock 150,000 units with an expected 27,000-unit loss when 30% are caught.
